scope: Two remaining audit bugs: overlapping one-shot location requests and custom web images after style replacement; remove the redundant browser location conversion wrapper.

findings.finding: Repeated one-shot location requests leave camera dispatch permanently blocked.
findings.change: A fresh acquisition resets dispatch ownership; generation guards still suppress stale completion and errors. Streaming resume retains its existing dispatch ownership.
findings.evidence: Four regression cases cover injected and service acquisition with older camera commands resolving or rejecting. A separate test preserves streaming coalescing, gesture interruption and resume without another watch. Existing native and web control suites pass.

findings.finding: A replacement style sprite with the same name substitutes for a registered custom image.
affectedPaths: Shared web Images for Mapbox and MapLibre
MapLibre sprite changes during in-place style diffs
findings.change: Style load retires installed-image ownership and pending loads before reconciling current entries. MapLibre getSprite value changes trigger the same reset. Explicit pending removals retain their existing retry contract.
findings.evidence: Ten cases across both web adapters cover ready and delayed styles, late load success/failure, unrelated sprite preservation and unmount before readiness. One MapLibre case covers sprite replacement through styledata without style.load and avoids reloads on ordinary styledata.
findings.boundaryReview: Inspected installed MapLibre 6.13.0 Map.getSprite, Style._updateDiff/setState/setSprite/_loadSprite, and ImageManager.setSpriteImages. Native images delegate registration to their existing wrappers and have no shared web ownership bookkeeping.

findings.finding: The browser geolocation conversion wrapper and its private event type are redundant.
affectedPaths: createWebUi default SDK geolocation callbacks for both web adapters
findings.change: Call positionFromWrapper directly with an unknown event; preserve validation, normalization and the committed callback guard.
findings.evidence: Existing browser geolocation forwarding and normalization tests pass. Repository search found no remaining references to the removed wrapper or private type.

regressions.beforeFixes: Four overlapping-location cases and ten style-replacement cases failed as expected; streaming coalescing already passed. The additional MapLibre in-place sprite replacement case also failed before its correction.
regressions.afterFixes: All 16 new cases pass in source and compiled web suites.
regressions.setupCorrection: The first type check rejected Promise.withResolvers in test code under the existing TypeScript library target. Tests now use the existing Promise callback pattern; type checks pass without configuration changes.

testScriptSubcommands.execution: Every package.json scripts.test command ran in source/native, standalone-script, and process-cleanup groups. Node and Bun process-cleanup tests used local process permissions; no renderer launched.

checks.manualReview: Reviewed all shared hook callers and generation changes, both image loader conventions, installed and pending image lifetimes, URL/sdf updates, pending removal retries, failure reporting, teardown/reuse, the browser normalization boundary, comments and current implementation documentation.

diagnostics: Nonblocking Bun moduleSuffixes and experimental TypeScript API warnings remain. React Compiler reports 17 optimization diagnostics, matching the previous recorded count; they do not represent runtime acceptance.
outstanding: Renderer acceptance for these repairs is explicitly deferred. Existing renderer results apply to their recorded artifacts.
outsideScope: Physical devices, browsers, simulators and emulators
New selected-peer installs and Metro transport; exports, dependency versions and linking are unchanged
retention: Package-check consumers and temporary archive cleaned themselves up. No raw logs, screenshots, native applications or acceptance workspaces were created.
